text_block_list.text: Summer training camp had ended, and while waiting for the bus to return to the academy together—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp is...
about to end, ssir...!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer!!
Why does summer training camp have to end?!
Why can't it be summer camp forever?!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Oooohhhh!! I wanna see more hell!
Summer, please don't end on me~~!!
choice_data_list: The Swan Stakes won't come until summer's over.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
――Farewell, summer!!
I'm off! To the Swan Stakes!!
choice_data_list: Let's come back next year, too!
Let's come back next year, too!

text_block_list.text:
"The Swan Stakes is steadily approaching...!
We have to psych ourselves up even more from here on out!"
